name: Compressible Low-Mach Channel 24x6
description: 2D open channel flow (inlet/outlet), isothermal dry air, low-Mach post-hoc EOS reinterpretation of an already-converged incompressible SIMPLE solve -- 24x6 structured Cartesian mesh. P6-PHYS-003: the first production physics.json case to exercise the compressible foundation end to end through CaseReader/CaseBuilder/ProjectRunner. Same physical reference constants and recipe as tests/integration/compressible/test_low_mach_regression.cpp's own validated Grid24 case (dry air: R=287.05 J/(kg K), cp=1005.0 J/(kg K), T=300 K isothermal, p_reference=101325 Pa). This is NOT a genuine compressible pressure-velocity solve -- see physics.json's own header comment and TODO.md's own P6-PHYS-003 status note.
